# Distinct Number of Papers and Datasets Found in the DCC

<br>

```{r}
#| label: fig-distinct-numbers
#| fig-cap: Distinct Number of Papers and Datasets in Found in the DCC
#| fig-format: png


combined_count_tibbles |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tibble_source, y = value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           position = "dodge",
           #fill = "#80CBC4",  # Light green fill
           color = "black") + # Black border for bars
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "gray30",
           alpha = 0.1, position = position_nudge(x = -0.05, y = -0.5)) +  # Shadow
  geom_text(aes(label = value), 
            vjust = -0.5,  # Adjust text position above the bars
            size = 4, 
            color = "black") + # Text color
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Mentioning Articles" = "#80CBC4",  # Custom color for variable1
    "Mentioned Datasets" = "#C1E8E1"  # Custom color for variable2
  )) +
  theme_classic() +  # Use classic theme
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(
    y = "Count")
```

# Distribution Frequency of Datasets References

```{r Distribution Frequency of Datasets References}

#| label: fig-datasets-freq-dist
#| fig-cap: Distribution Frequency of Datasets References
#| fig-format: png


ds_freq |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = n)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 10,                  # Adjust bins to log-scaled data
    color = "black", fill = NA
  ) +
  stat_bin(
    bins = 10,                  # Same binning as histograms
    geom = "text",
    aes(label = ..count..),
    vjust = -0.3,               # Position labels above bars
    size = 5                    # Font size of labels
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(1, 3, 10, 40, 100),  # Custom breaks for the x-axis
    labels = c(1, 3, 10, 40, 100)   # Labels for x-axis
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of mentions (log scale)",
    y = "Number of Datasets (log scale)"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

```

# Distribution of References Across Repositories

```{r Distribution of References Across Repositories}

#| label: fig-repo-dist
#| fig-cap: Distribution of References Across Repositories
#| fig-format: png


rep_dt |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(repository, n), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           position = "dodge",
           fill = "#80CBC4",
           color = "black") +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "gray30",
           alpha = 0.2, position = position_nudge(x = -0.05, y = -0.1)) +  # Shadow
geom_text(aes(y = n + 2, label = n),
            vjust = 0.5,
            hjust = 0,
            size = 5, color = "black") + # text next to bars
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.15))) + # Adds 5% padding on both sides of the y-axis
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Repository", y = "Number of Mentions") +
  theme_classic()

```

# Datasets References by Year

```{r Datasets References by Year}

#| label: fig-ref-by-year
#| fig-cap: Datasets References by Year
#| fig-format: png


year_dcc_dt_all_for_plot_agg |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(publication_year_dcc), fill = factor(charite_data_id_or_acc_nr))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           position = "stack",
           aes(y = count)) +
geom_text(
  data = year_dcc_dt_all_for_plot_agg |>
    group_by(publication_year_dcc) |>
    dplyr::filter(!(publication_year_dcc %in% c(2012, 2013, 2015, 2017) & count == min(count))),  # Exclude only in specific years
  aes(y = count, label = count),
  position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Accession Number"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#E89FB4", "#5DAF9E", "#F4A261", "#87CEFA", "grey")) +
  theme_classic()
```

# Datasets Access, Repositories and Covid-relationship

```{r Datasets Access, Repositories and Covid-relationship}

#| label: fig-datasets-properties
#| fig-cap: Datasets Access, Repositories and Covid-relationship gray
#| fig-format: png


# Create a function for verifying the links df structure, extracting its entities and finally plotting it:

get_nodes_from_links <- function(links) {
  stopifnot(all(c("source", "target", "value") %in% names(links)))
  data.frame(
    name = unique(c(as.character(links$source), as.character(links$target)))
  )
}

plot_Sankey <- function(links, ...) {
  nodes <- get_nodes_from_links(links)

  # Assign group labels to nodes
  # Map directly to colors
  highlight_colors <- list(
    "Accession Number" = "blue",
    "DOI" = "red",
    "Full Access" = "yellow",
    "Restricted Access" = "green",
    "Not Covid Related" = "purple",
    "Covid Related" = "pink",
    "covid not checked yet" = "white"
  )

  # Assign group (color name) to each node, default to gray
  nodes$group <- sapply(nodes$name, function(n) {
    if (!is.null(highlight_colors[[n]])) highlight_colors[[n]] else "gray"
  })

  links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name) - 1
  links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name) - 1

  # Color scale: domain = unique group values (colors), range = same
  color_domain <- unique(nodes$group)
  domain_str <- paste0('"', color_domain, '"', collapse = ", ")
  range_str <- paste0('"', color_domain, '"', collapse = ", ")
  my_color <- paste0(
    "d3.scaleOrdinal()",
    ".domain([", domain_str, "])",
    ".range([", range_str, "])"
  )

  sankeyNetwork(
    Links = links, Nodes = nodes,
    Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget",
    Value = "value", NodeID = "name",
    NodeGroup = "group",  # ← now using color group directly
    colourScale = my_color,
    ...
  )
}

# Plot

plot_Sankey(links_all, sinksRight = FALSE, fontSize = 20)

s_plot <- plot_Sankey(links_all, sinksRight = FALSE, fontSize = 20)

saveWidget(s_plot, file = here("data", "processed", "dcc_charite_joined", "sankey_interactive_plot.html"), selfcontained = TRUE)


```

# Datasets and Citing Papers Publication Years

```{r Datasets and Citing Papers Publication Years}

#| label: fig-datasets-and-papers-years
#| fig-cap: Datasets and Citing Papers Publication Years
#| fig-format: png


dif_for_plot |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = dif)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1,
    boundary = -0.5,
    color = "black", fill = NA
  ) +
  stat_bin(
    binwidth = 1,
    boundary = -0.5,
    geom = "text",
    aes(label = ..count..),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:15) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:9) +
  labs(
    x = "Years Between Dataset and Article Publication",
    y = "Number of Datasets"
  ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10))
    )
```
